title: The Axe's Grudge - How to Earn & Missable Status (Phantom Blade Zero)
description: The Axe's Grudge trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and rarity once the list is public.
keyword: The Axe's Grudge phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Drops the Dread Axe. A straight fight with a long wind-up, so it is the cleanest place to practise parrying a heavy.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This entry is filled from the shipped game on either platform; PS5 trophy and PC achievement lists are recorded separately where they differ. See the trophy guide for the full list and how long to beat for run-length context.
